offering_description.value: Provides surface freight transportation and logistics for shippers across North America. It moves containers by rail with its own container fleet and drayage, runs dedicated contract and for-hire trucks, arranges brokered loads, and delivers heavy bulky goods to homes.

primary_services.value: intermodal container transport; dedicated contract trucking; truckload and freight brokerage; final-mile delivery of large goods; flatbed and expedited freight

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, manufacturers, consumer goods and e-commerce shippers

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; manufacturing; e-commerce; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight transportation, brokerage and delivery charges per load or shipment; project or contract: multi-year dedicated contract trucking agreements

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns containers, tractors, trailers and chassis, hauls freight for shippers; service provider: brokerage and final-mile services using third-party carriers and railroads

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with cross-border service in Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: intermodal, dedicated contract, truckload, final-mile delivery and brokerage freight services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving shippers and national accounts; online: digital freight marketplace for carriers and shippers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: trucking safety, hours-of-service and emissions rules from DOT, FMCSA and EPA
